decimal_rule: finite-normalized-decimal-string; IEEE-754 float forbidden in identity material
timestamp_rule: RFC3339 UTC with six fractional digits and Z suffix
null_absent_rule: null is a value; absent means the key is omitted; they are never equivalent
source_position_rule: kind plus canonical string value; comparisons require identical kinds

identity_profiles.payload_digest: semantic envelope excluding event_id, payload_digest, ingested_at, and quarantine_reason
identity_profiles.proof_manifest_digest: sealed gate results plus generation/frontier/schema/input revision
identity_profiles.evidence_manifest_digest: repository-relative artifact paths, SHA-256 digests, producer commit/run/tool versions

limitations: This profile is a local reference authority, not proof of adapter conformance.
Filesystem normalization applies only to evidence paths and forbids absolute or parent-traversal paths.
